title: 6 Times a Godly Man Goes First Into the Cost
caption:
Leadership isn't a title. It's the guy who moves first when moving costs him something.

The apology before he's fully wrong. The job nobody wants. The blame he didn't earn. Six ways a godly man goes first, before anyone asks him to.

Save this and pick one to do this week.

#godlyman #leadership #christianmen #biblicalmanhood #service #humility
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
